gloss: seagrass bed; seaweed bed; underwater meadow

definitions.gloss: seagrass bed; seaweed bed; underwater meadow
definitions.explanation: A shallow coastal area densely covered with seagrass or seaweed. Valued as a spawning and nursery ground for fish, and treated in environmental policy as a habitat to be protected and restored.

examples.japanese: {湾|わん}の{奥|おく}に{藻場|もば}が{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: A seagrass bed spreads across the inner part of the bay.

examples.japanese: {藻場|もば}は{魚|さかな}の{産卵場所|さんらんばしょ}になっている。
examples.english: Seagrass beds serve as spawning grounds for fish.

examples.japanese: {水温|すいおん}の{上昇|じょうしょう}で、この{地域|ちいき}の{藻場|もば}が{減|へ}り{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: Rising water temperatures have caused the seagrass beds in this area to keep shrinking.

examples.japanese: {漁協|ぎょきょう}と{大学|だいがく}が{協力|きょうりょく}して、{失|うしな}われた{藻場|もば}を{再生|さいせい}する{取|と}り{組|く}みを{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: The fishery cooperative and the university have jointly begun an effort to restore the lost seagrass beds.

notes:
Formed from {藻|も} (algae, water plants) + {場|ば} (place). A technical term from fisheries and marine conservation, common in news coverage of coastal environments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {藻場|もば}が{広|ひろ}がる: seagrass beds spread
- {藻場|もば}の{再生|さいせい}: restoration of seagrass beds
- {藻場|もば}が{消失|しょうしつ}する: seagrass beds disappear

RELATED TERMS:
- {磯焼|いそや}け: barren ground — the loss of seaweed beds along rocky coasts, the problem {藻場|もば} restoration addresses
- {干潟|ひがた}: tidal flat — another shallow-water habitat protected for similar reasons
